property_mappings.reasoning: shipname is the vessel's name, which maps to conceptName from the Concept class inherited by Vessel.
type_name describes the vessel type, matching typeName from Object.
max_speed is the vessel maximum speed, matching vesselMaximumSpeed.
flag is a two-letter country code, matching geopoliticalAffiliationCode.
flag is a country code for the vessel, mapping to a GeopoliticalAffiliation.
The standard code is a fixed value 'IMO' for the IMO number.
The imo column holds the IMO number.
imo is an alternate vessel identifier, mapping to AlternateIdentifier with IMO standard.
The standard code is fixed as 'CALLSIGN' for radio call signs.
callsign column holds the call sign.
callsign is a radio call sign identifier, mapping to AlternateIdentifier.
timestamp column is the observation date/time, matching observationDateTime.
lat column is latitude in decimal degrees.
lon column is longitude in decimal degrees.
A point geometry is described by lat/lon.
lat/lon represent a geographic position, linking to a Location.
The combination of lat, lon, timestamp represents an observation of the vessel at a point in time.
speed is given and maps to speed in m/s (unit mismatch noted but raw value used).
course is the bearing in degrees, matching absoluteBearingAngle.
speed and course together describe the vessel's velocity.
heading column directly provides heading angle.
heading is the vessel heading in degrees, matching headingAngle.
destination is a text field with no direct match; mapped to additionalInformationText as a loose fallback.

subject_mappings.reasoning: mmsi is the unique Maritime Mobile Service Identity for vessels, and Vessel is the appropriate ontology class.

property_mappings.reasoning: last_port column gives the port name, matching locationName.
The standard is fixed as 'UN/LOCODE' for UN location codes.
last_port_unlocode holds the actual code.
last_port_unlocode is a UN/LOCODE, an alternate port identifier.
The country code maps to geopoliticalAffiliationCode.
last_port_country is a country code, mapping to GeopoliticalAffiliation for the port.

subject_mappings.reasoning: last_port_id is a numeric identifier for a port, and Port is the ontology class for maritime ports.
